heroPixelSectionContent.title: Some stories do not arrive loudly. They begin softly, and then become everything.
heroPixelSectionContent.body: It starts quietly, right in the center, like the first thing I wanted you to see. Then as you scroll, the words drift aside and the scattered pixels come together, because that is exactly what you did to my life too.
heroPixelSectionContent.hint: Scroll slowly. This story was never meant to be rushed.

memoriesSectionContent.title: A whole section just for the moments that still replay in my chest.
memoriesSectionContent.intro: I kept this one separate on purpose. It deserves its own atmosphere, its own pace, and its own kind of softness.
memoriesSectionContent.body: This gallery is meant to feel like flipping through memories that never really went away. The motion is dreamy, the colors stay inside the same romantic palette, and every image can be replaced from one file whenever you want.
memoriesSectionContent.aside: Right now these are dummy images, but the structure is ready for your real photos or Cloudinary public IDs whenever you want to swap them in.
lines: A random meeting, but somehow it changed everything.
From study talks to smiles I started waiting for.
You asked for my number, and maybe that was where fate quietly smiled.
Those formal conversations never knew they would become this close.
The same PG, the same days, and slowly the same comfort.
Late-night calls made the distance between two hearts disappear.
Every outing with you became a memory I still replay.
Love came softly, but once it came, it felt like home.

relationshipMilestones.label: Childhood
relationshipMilestones.title: Silent, innocent, and already special.
relationshipMilestones.description: As a little girl, you were quiet, innocent, and full of a sweet kind of cleverness. You were not the loud kind of shine, you were the soft kind that people slowly notice and never forget.

relationshipMilestones.label: Growing Up
relationshipMilestones.title: You kept collecting the best from every stage of life.
relationshipMilestones.description: In childhood, you pulled the highest marks in almost every subject, as if excellence had already chosen you. You grew up carrying that same brilliance with grace, sincerity, and a heart that stayed soft no matter how much you achieved.

relationshipMilestones.label: Becoming You
relationshipMilestones.title: Beauty, innocence, and strength all in one soul.
relationshipMilestones.description: As you grew, you did not just become more beautiful, you became more graceful, more understanding, and even more precious. The lovely thing about you is that your outer beauty is only one part of what makes you so unforgettable.

journeySectionContent.title: Some beauties are created slowly, but on the day Saniya was born, the world received one all at once.
journeySectionContent.intro: Sometimes I really feel thankful to your parents for bringing someone like you into this world. You are pretty, beautiful, innocent, and full of a softness that is very rare. There are many ways to describe beauty, but honestly, you feel beyond all of them.
journeySectionContent.closing: No camera, no photo, and no eyes can fully capture your real beauty, because the most beautiful part of you is not only how you look, it is also how you are.

colorRevealSectionContent.title: Before you, everything looked complete. It just did not feel alive.
colorRevealSectionContent.body: Before you came into my life, the world moved the way it always does. Days opened and closed, people passed by, work filled the hours, and everything looked normal from the outside. But somewhere inside, it all felt quiet, distant, almost colorless, like life was happening in shades instead of feeling.
colorRevealSectionContent.bodyTwo: Then you arrived, and without noise, everything began to glow differently. The same days softened, the same moments became warmer, and the same world started carrying color I had never noticed before. You did not just enter my life, Saniya. You turned it from something I was living into something I could finally feel.

loveReasons.title: Your eyes
loveReasons.subtitle: The first thing that quietly makes everything else disappear.
loveReasons.description: Her eyes feel like home to me, quiet, warm, and the one place I never get tired of getting lost in. When she looks at me, the whole world fades into the background, and suddenly that one moment becomes enough for my heart.

loveReasons.title: Your smile
loveReasons.subtitle: The version of joy that never needs an explanation.
loveReasons.description: Her smile makes me forget my anger, my stress, my tension, and everything that weighs on me. The moment that soft smile appears, the whole world goes quiet, and I just melt into it like nothing else ever mattered.

loveReasons.title: Your anger
loveReasons.subtitle: Even your storms feel real in a way I cannot ignore.
loveReasons.description: Even when she is angry, she is impossible not to adore. Her little frowns, those spark-filled eyes, and the way she tries to stay serious only make her look even more precious, like a tiny storm that was made to be loved, not feared.

loveReasons.title: Your looks
loveReasons.subtitle: Even your storms feel real in a way I cannot ignore.
loveReasons.description: There is something about the way she looks that stays with me long after the moment is gone. It is not just beauty, it is the softness, the grace, and the kind of presence that makes it impossible to look away.

loveReasons.title: Your childishness
loveReasons.subtitle: The playful little chaos that makes being around you unforgettable.
loveReasons.description: When she is with me, there is a little girl in her that comes alive, playful, carefree, and full of wonder. In those moments, her laughter feels pure, her happiness feels simple, and my heart falls for her in the softest way all over again.

closingLines: You have this rare way of making life feel more detailed.
More golden. More memorable. More worth pausing for.
This page is only a small attempt at saying what you actually deserve to hear in person.
You are loved deeply, admired endlessly, and thought about far more often than I know how to summarize.

letterSectionContent.title: A softer ending feels stronger than a loud one here.
letterSectionContent.personalizationBody: I kept the writing romantic and polished, but still generic enough to be safe as a first pass. Once you answer a few personal questions, I can turn this into something that feels unmistakably hers.

finalSectionContent.title: Better structure, smoother scroll, and sections that finally feel connected.
